example_session.transport: MCP streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18, stateless (no Mcp-Session-Id header returned). One JSON-RPC object per POST; batching is refused.

requests.response_summary: result.tools has 10 tools: rates_latest, convert, convert_many, fx_rates_for, rate_history, rate_on, currencies_list, cache_status, license_status, license_activate. Each has name, title, description, inputSchema.

result.content[0].text is a JSON string: amount, from, to, rate 1.113, rate_date 2026-10-29, result "USD 111.30", source European Central Bank. result.content[1].text is a free-tier line: 600 calls/hour, 30-day retention, Pro link.

limits.calls_free: 600 per hour per token (counter resets at the top of the UTC hour)
limits.token_mints: 10 per hour per IP. Reuse your token.
limits.data_retention: 30 days on free. Idle data swept after 35 days
limits.request_body: 256 KB per request (base64 files: about 190 KB)
limits.stored_per_token_per_server: 512 KB default. 2 MB for spreadsheet, docx, resume, pdf, calendar, image, bank-statement, zip, cash-book
limits.server_free_limits: Each server keeps its own free-tier limits (example: invoice_create 3 per month).

errors.meaning: tools/call on the bare URL with no token.
Token has the right form but the server doesn't know it (expired, mistyped, or never minted).
errors.fix: Mint a new token: curl -s -X POST https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token

errors.meaning: Token is neither anon_<32 hex> nor an MCPL1 Pro key.
errors.fix: Copy the whole token. Check for spaces or a missing prefix.

errors.meaning: The token made 600 calls this hour. Body has resets_at and retry_after_seconds.
errors.fix: Wait for resets_at, or buy Pro (6000 per hour). Clients that re-handshake every turn spend calls before any tool runs.

errors.meaning: Your IP minted 10 tokens this hour.
errors.fix: Reuse the token you have. One token is one data space.

errors.meaning: Unknown server id in the URL.
errors.fix: Check the id against GET https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp (endpoints list).

errors.meaning: A GET without Accept: text/event-stream (for example, opening the URL in a browser).
errors.fix: Send POST with a JSON-RPC body. A browser can't test the URL.

errors.meaning: /mcp/token called with a method other than GET or POST.
HTTP 200, but the tool name or arguments are wrong. Example: Tool nope not found.
errors.fix: Call tools/list and use an exact tool name and the inputSchema.

architecture.summary: Each server is a small TypeScript or JavaScript program that speaks MCP. It runs on your machine over stdio, or on a hosted endpoint over streamable HTTP. The tool contract is the same on both paths.
points: On the local stdio path, your MCP client starts node dist/index.js. Nothing leaves your machine except calls the tool itself needs (example: currency fetches ECB rates).
The local install keeps JSON files under ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/mcp-servers/<server>/. Writes are atomic (temp file + rename). Delete the folder to reset a server.

business_set writes one shared business profile to ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/mcp-servers/profile/business.json. Invoice, quotes, credit notes and the other document servers read it, so you set your name, address, VAT id and defaults once.

The Pro key is read from MCP_LICENSE_KEY, then ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/mcp-servers/license.json, then the free tier applies. Keys (MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>) are checked offline with Ed25519. No phone-home.

On the hosted path (streamable HTTP), 46 of 58 servers run on a Cloudflare Worker at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/<server>. Data is stored per token, kept 30 days, and file tools take inline uploads and return download URLs that expire.
Four servers are local only: office-suite, three-way-match, duplicate-invoice-check and supplier-statement-check have no hosted URL. Use the .mcpb bundle, npm or a source build.
Every server registers license_status and license_activate. Call license_status first to prove the transport works.

conventions.title: Tool results
conventions.text: Success: {content:[{type:"text",text}]}. Failure: the same shape with isError: true and text that starts with Error:. Servers don't throw across the transport.

conventions.title: Money in minor units
conventions.text: Many servers store and return amounts as integer minor units (cents). Some inputs, such as invoice unit_price, take major units. Each tool description says which.

conventions.title: Free tier inside the tool
conventions.text: A free-tier limit is a normal tool result that names the limit and the upgrade URL. It isn't a protocol error.

conventions.title: Logging
conventions.text: Servers log to stderr only. stdout carries only protocol messages. One readiness line goes to stderr at start.

conventions.title: Contracts are generated
conventions.text: Each server has SPEC.md, generated from the built server by scripts/gen-spec.mjs: every tool, every argument, type and required flag.

conventions.title: Tests
conventions.text: Each server has test/smoke.test.mjs. It spawns dist/index.js and runs initialize, tools/list and one tools/call over stdio.

conventions.title: Stack
conventions.text: TypeScript, ESM, Node 18 or newer, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and zod. No native dependencies, so npx works on every platform. MIT license.

faq.a: Yes. npm view @theluckystrike/mcp-currency returns 0.22.6 (checked 2026-10-30). Some older pages and llms-install.md files still say it isn't published. They are out of date.

faq.q: Why does my hosted URL list tools but every call fails?
faq.a: You used the bare URL. It answers initialize and tools/list, and returns 401 on tools/call. Add the token: /mcp/<server>/t/<token>, or send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

faq.q: Is the URL with the token a secret?
faq.a: Yes. The token in the URL is the credential and your data space. Don't share it or commit it.

faq.q: Can I test the hosted URL in a browser?
faq.a: No. A browser GET returns 406. Use curl with POST and a JSON-RPC body, as in the example session.

faq.q: Does the hosted endpoint support OAuth?
faq.a: The server publishes OAuth discovery documents and an authorize endpoint. The /mcp index says it has no OAuth flow. Use the token forms. They are tested.
On the local install, in ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/mcp-servers/<server>/. On the hosted path, on the server per token for 30 days, refreshed on every write.

faq.q: How do I move from free to Pro?
faq.a: Buy at https://mcp.zovo.one/buy/<server> ($19) or /buy/bundle ($39). Then set MCP_LICENSE_KEY or call license_activate once. On hosted, the Pro key can be sent as the token.
